note: 'Benchmarks measure style, not smoke' with a ranking-flip demonstration is a field-resetting audit; smoke-density/matting lines exist so the agreement-study leg must carry novelty. Lit-attacked below.
The regression-beats-binary-ON-binary claim is crisp and falsifiable; pairs naturally with 0076 as its constructive half. Compositing realism is the shared weak point.
Artifact-reliance for emissive phenomena is a real deployment issue; the saturation-is-also-signal confound (own note) demands HDR counterfactuals that raise the cost.

Flicker-frequency analysis is the backbone of 2000s-era video fire detection (wavelet flicker methods, ~10 Hz signatures); the matched-FLOPs modern restaging is engineering, not discovery. Compression caveat is the one live finding.
Occlusion-based information decomposition is standard interpretability machinery applied to a fresh class pair; the matched-scene-pair control decides whether the number means anything.
Divergence-as-earliness on ignition-anchored videos is a well-posed physics bet; flow noise at low contrast (own note) may eat the earliness margin, which is exactly what the experiment measures.
Measuring the implicit alpha-cutoff distribution of annotators is original psychophysics with direct dataset-harmonization payoff; controlled alpha ramps make it decisive.
Synthetic-to-real fog transfer was the explicit subject of the Foggy Cityscapes/Foggy Zurich/CMAda line (Sakaridis et al.); the heterogeneity-index regression is a residual, not a paper.
Contrast-sign regime stratification is a solid dataset audit but reads as one figure in a bigger smoke-benchmark paper (e.g. inside 0076) rather than standalone work.
Sun-geometry forensic verification of label errors is a genuinely new audit instrument (labels falsified by celestial mechanics); off-nadir overlap geometry is the technical hurdle.
Shutter-speed-as-confound is a sharp observation about weather datasets; controlled capture logistics push the decisive version out of reach, and the simulation version convinces nobody.
Ripple-amplitude psychometric curve for reflection confusion is clean and cheap; overlaps the C05 mirror agenda - merge candidate with the phantom-source census (0125-adjacent).
Steam-vs-smoke as a minimal pair is the right way to isolate the discriminative cue for translucent media; deliberate source-variety collection is the real cost and worth it.

'Information is destroyed before the model' is the right counter-narrative to scaling; requires controlled-burn bracketed capture, and legacy-camera inapplicability (own note) blunts the deployment claim.

Time-to-detect reformulation is the highest-value framing in the cluster, BUT the wildfire camera-network line (FIgLib/SmokeyNet, tower-camera programs) already benchmarks detection latency - the segmentation-vs-accumulation duel is the surviving question. Lit-attacked below.

Human-preference validation of segmentation metrics for amorphous classes could reorder the subfield; per-use-case preference collection (own note) is the difference between a metric paper and an opinion poll.
Super-multiplicative failure on translucency compositions is a good compositional-generalization probe; physical capture of stacked media is a real logistics bill.
The fire-invariant/smoke-not split is a nice physics prediction; scale confounds with distance, atmosphere and compression make the clean ladder hard to certify.
Factorial realism ablation answers the question every synthetic-data team guesses at; 8-cell render+train grid is a heavy compute bill for a cluster of this kind.
Ego-motion compensation for aerial temporal cues is competent engineering hygiene; the synthetic-ego-motion protocol lacks parallax by its own admission, and the finding is an ablation table.
Band attribution for the smoke/shadow confusion is useful to the remote-sensing community (venue fit is there, not CVPR); retrain-without-band leg makes it honest.
Passive shimmer segmentation as a pre-smoke fire channel is the most original constructive idea in C04; wind/vibration confounds are real but controllable on fixed cameras. Protect as HRHR.

METAR-validated self-supervised fog density is a lovely free-label loop; depth-estimator circularity (own note) plus existing visibility-estimation literature in transportation research keep it at borderline pending a lit check.
Hours-cheap shortcut audit (mask the fire, watch accuracy persist) with a paired auto/fixed-exposure confirmation; inpainting-leak caveat is handled by multiple masking strategies.
Provenance-level leakage audit of smoke/fire benchmarks is cheap, decisive, and likely devastating; the genre exists in other domains, which helps rather than hurts the method's credibility.
